newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 19.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 19.

text.p: - All Mexican ports were open on Monday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.

Warm temperatures and isolated rains along Jalisco, Colima and Michoacan and expected later in the day along Oaxaca, Guerrero and Chiapas. Maximum winds from 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves four to six feet high.

Warm weather with light rains expected later in the day along Tamaulipas, Veracruz, Tabasco and the Yucatan peninsula with possible electric storms in the northeast gulf. Winds at 10 to 15 knots and waves three to five feet high.
Hot and partly cloudy with winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
